review.finding: Round 1: _nested() only ran on the last segment of each line. FIXED: every emitted segment goes through _emit().
Round 1: redirect tokens (2>&1, &>, >|) leaked into push args. FIXED.
Round 1: backslash continuations, bash -lc clusters, heredoc bodies and whole-line comments mishandled. FIXED.
Round 1: extractor printed in the Windows locale code page; a non-cp1252 character blanked the command and all guards failed open. FIXED: UTF-8 bytes; emoji regression test.

PR review (twice) and delta review: with no interpreter / a missing or crashing guard only exit 3 blocked, so a force push to main/master passed silently. FIXED: exit 4 = cannot decide; any status other than 0/3 degrades to a coarse over-blocking check (push + force flag incl. +refspec + main/master anywhere); no interpreter no longer exits 0 at the top.

Delta review: when Python exists but its extractor fails (lone surrogate) the command was blank and every check was skipped. FIXED: encode errors=replace, and an empty result falls through to a portable sed extractor; test added.
Delta review: sed alternation was a GNU BRE extension. FIXED: portable ERE (sed -nE).

Delta review: first coarse fallback let through git -C . push, HEAD:main, +main, tab-separated forms. FIXED: widened fallback and \\[nt] normalisation; cases added to tests; stderr notice cannot abort the block (|| true).
Delta review: the no-interpreter test omitted the real guard, so it did not prove the interpreter was the cause. FIXED: real guard copied; sed-path cases added.

current_branch reads the hook cwd, not a cd'd or submodule repo. PARTIAL: git -C honoured; cd <dir> && and submodule foreach remain documented limits. --tags-only on main is a rare accepted false positive.
